targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investigation_sessions WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retrospective_hunt_queries WHERE status = 'executed'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM investigation_sessions GROUP BY status
SELECT node_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM investigation_graph_nodes WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY node_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(mitre_tactic, 'unknown') as tactic, COUNT(*) as count FROM investigation_timeline_events GROUP BY mitre_tactic ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as sessions FROM investigation_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as links FROM investigation_evidence_links WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT entity_id, node_type, COUNT(*) as pivot_count, AVG(risk_score) as avg_risk FROM investigation_graph_nodes WHERE is_pivot_origin = true GROUP BY entity_id, node_type ORDER BY pivot_count DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT event_category, mitre_technique, mitre_tactic, ROUND(confidence::numeric, 2) as confidence, occurred_at FROM investigation_timeline_events ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT relationship_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM investigation_graph_edges GROUP BY relationship_type

SELECT 'graph_nodes' as table_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_advisory = false) as non_advisory_count FROM investigation_graph_nodes UNION ALL SELECT 'graph_edges', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_advisory = false) FROM investigation_graph_edges UNION ALL SELECT 'timeline_events', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_advisory = false) FROM investigation_timeline_events UNION ALL SELECT 'evidence_links', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_advisory = false) FROM investigation_evidence_links
